Title: Azure Kinect DK is now available in Japan, Germany, and the UK

Body.Content:
Due to considerable market interest, Azure Kinect DK is now generally available in Japan, Germany, and the UK.

Azure Kinect DK is a developer kit with advanced AI sensors for building sophisticated computer vision and speech models. Designed for versatility, it combines an advanced depth sensor and spatial microphone array with a video camera and orientation sensor, along with multiple modes, options and SDKs.

Learn more about Azure Kinect DK
